sentences.text: John Patrick McEnroe Jr. -LRB- born February 16 , 1959 -RRB- is an American former World No. 1 professional tennis player , often rated among the greatest players of all time in the sport , especially for his touch on the volley .	World No. 1	Lists of ATP number 1 ranked players	tennis	tennis

He won seven Grand Slam singles titles -LRB- three at Wimbledon and four at the US Open -RRB- , nine Grand Slam men 's doubles titles , and one Grand Slam mixed doubles title .	Grand Slam	Grand Slam (tennis)	Wimbledon	Wimbledon Championships	US Open	US Open (tennis)

He also won a record eight year-end championships , 19 Grand Prix Super Series titles , and finished his career with 77 ATP-listed singles titles and 78 in doubles .	record eight year-end championships	Tennis records of the Open Era – men's singles#Year-end championships	Grand Prix Super Series	Grand Prix Super Series

McEnroe is known for his shot-making artistry and volleying skills ; for his rivalries with Björn Borg , Jimmy Connors and Ivan Lendl ; and for his confrontational on-court behavior , which frequently landed him in trouble with umpires and tennis authorities .	tennis	tennis	Björn Borg	Björn Borg	Jimmy Connors	Jimmy Connors	Ivan Lendl	Ivan Lendl

In 1981 , 1983 and 1984 he was both the ATP player of the year and the ITF World Champion for Men 's singles .	1983	1983 World Championship Tennis Finals - Singles	1984	1984 World Championship Tennis Finals - Singles	1981	1981 World Championship Tennis Finals - Singles

His match record of 82 -- 3 in 1984 remains the best single season win rate of the Open Era .	1984	1984 World Championship Tennis Finals - Singles	best single season win rate	Tennis records of the Open Era – men's singles#Single season records	Open Era	History of tennis#Open Era
McEnroe is a former Captain of the United States Davis Cup team and as a player was part of five Cup-winning teams .	United States	United States	Davis Cup	Davis Cup
He continues to play tennis and competes in senior events on the ATP Champions Tour .	tennis	tennis	ATP Champions Tour	ATP Champions Tour
He was inducted into the International Tennis Hall of Fame in 1999 and received the Philippe Chatrier Award in 2007 .	International Tennis Hall of Fame	International Tennis Hall of Fame
After his tennis career he became a television commentator , a game show host and a chat show host .	tennis	tennis
Additionally , he has appeared in several films and television shows as himself and has played music live .

He has been married since 1997 to musician and former Scandal lead singer Patty Smyth ; they have six children between them -LRB- two together -RRB- .	Scandal	Scandal (American band)	Patty Smyth	Patty Smyth
